name: Sneak
description: Move quietly, hide from enemies and sense nearby threats.
training: Move while sneaking on the ground, or sneak near enemy mobs.
Land melee hits on enemy mobs while sneaking. Attacking players does not train Sneak.
rules: Sneak for three seconds to hide beyond your concealment range. Standing or using Ambush reveals you; damage keeps you visible for 15 seconds.
Threat Sense can spot hidden players within 20 blocks. Only the player using it sees them.
Speed bonuses affect sneaking, not walking or sprinting. Minecraft’s speed limits still apply.

traits.name: Concealment I
traits.description: Hide your body, gear and name from players and mobs beyond 25 blocks. Damage reveals you for 15 seconds.

traits.name: Soft Landing
traits.description: Take 25% less fall damage when you land sneaking, for falls up to 20 blocks.

traits.name: Concealment II
traits.description: Stay hidden from players and mobs beyond 20 blocks.

traits.name: Pickpocket
traits.description: Sneak behind an unaware humanoid enemy within 3 blocks. Empty-hand right-click, then stay still for two seconds to steal a gold nugget. Once per mob; not players.

traits.name: Ambush
traits.description: Hit an unaware enemy or player from behind for +25% base melee damage. No recent combat between you; using it reveals you and starts a 15-second cooldown. Protection applies.

traits.name: Concealment III
traits.description: Stay hidden from players and mobs beyond 15 blocks.

traits.name: Night Vision
traits.description: Sneak for more than three seconds to see in the dark. Stand to end it.

traits.name: Concealment IV
traits.description: Stay hidden from players and mobs beyond 12.5 blocks.

traits.name: Threat Sense
traits.description: Sneak for more than three seconds to see enemies and players through walls within 20 blocks. Only you see the outlines; stand to end it.

traits.name: Master Concealment
traits.description: Stay hidden beyond 10 blocks. Keep your +200% sneak-speed bonus.

traits.name: Shadow title
traits.description: Choose the Shadow title in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Farming
description: Grow better harvests and unlock ore trees that produce resources.
training: Harvest fully grown crops yourself, including wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, cocoa and sweet berries.
Harvest naturally grown pumpkins and melons. Planting, tilling, placed fruit and automatic farms do not train Farming.
rules: Crop bonuses need you online and within 32 blocks of crops you planted. Normal light, water and soil requirements still apply.
Growth boosts help crops grow sooner, but harvest times vary. Double harvests do not double seeds or XP.
Ore trees produce resources, not Farming XP. They work in loaded chunks even while you’re offline, with up to 10 registered trees per type.

traits.name: Cultivation
traits.description: Level up for up to 25% crop growth and double-harvest bonuses. Growth boosts need you online within 32 blocks of your crops.

traits.name: Seed Saver
traits.description: 10% chance to keep the item used to plant a crop.

traits.name: Replant
traits.description: Auto-replant ripe crops using one planting item from your inventory.

traits.name: Harvest Pouch
traits.description: Auto-collect crops and seeds. Extras drop if your inventory is full.

traits.name: Green Thumb
traits.description: 15% chance to keep bone meal when it helps a supported crop grow.

traits.name: Light Footed
traits.description: Your footsteps cannot trample farmland.

traits.name: Seed Saver II
traits.description: 25% chance to keep the item used to plant a crop.

traits.name: Master Farmer
traits.description: Turn on, then sneak-harvest with a hoe to gather up to nine ripe crops in a 3×3 area.

traits.name: Harvestmaster title
traits.description: Choose the Harvestmaster title in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Mining
description: Mine faster, find hidden ores and unlock spells for bigger excavations.
training: Use a pickaxe to mine natural stone and ores.
Rarer ores give more experience. Blocks placed by players do not count.
rules: Silk Touch cannot double ores. Fortune works normally, and its drops can then be doubled.
Prospector chimes toward your chosen ore within 12 blocks.
Master Miner breaks up to 12 connected natural ores of the same type. It cannot bypass protection.

traits.name: Careful Hands
traits.description: 10% chance to save mining durability; rises to 20% at level 75.

traits.name: Deep Pockets
traits.description: Auto-collect drops. Extras drop if your inventory is full.

traits.name: Steady Footing
traits.description: Mine at normal speed while airborne. Underwater penalties still apply.

traits.name: Veinsight
traits.description: Spell Menu: 3 runes reveal nearby natural ores privately.

traits.name: Prospector
traits.description: Choose an ore in your journal. Follow its directional chime within 12 blocks.

traits.name: Demolition Training
traits.description: 25% less damage from TNT and TNT minecarts, regardless of owner.

traits.name: Earthshatter I
traits.description: Dig a 3×3×3 tunnel for 5 runes through the Spell Menu. Protection applies.

traits.name: Careful Hands II
traits.description: 20% chance to save mining durability.

traits.name: Earthshatter II
traits.description: Dig a longer 3×3×10 tunnel for 10 runes.

traits.name: Master Miner
traits.description: Turn on, then sneak-mine up to 12 connected natural ores of the same type. Normal drops, durability and protection apply.

traits.name: Earthshaper title
traits.description: Choose the Earthshaper title in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Woodcutting
description: Save tool durability, replant saplings and learn to fell whole trees.
training: Use an axe to harvest logs and stems from trees or nether fungi. Trees grown from your own saplings count too.
Placed or stripped logs, leaves, decorative wood, bamboo and mushrooms do not train Woodcutting.
rules: Replant uses saplings from your inventory after you finish harvesting a recognized tree.
Canopy Care makes sapling and apple drops 50% more likely, rather than adding a flat 50% chance.
Unusual or oversized trees may need manual chopping. Nether fungi must be replanted by hand.

traits.name: Chopping Speed
traits.description: Gain up to +50% chopping speed as you level.

traits.name: Timber Yield
traits.description: Gain up to a 25% chance to double wood drops as you level.

traits.name: Steady Axe
traits.description: 10% chance to save axe durability when chopping eligible logs.

traits.name: Replant
traits.description: Auto-replant after harvesting a whole tree, using saplings from your inventory.

traits.name: Lumber Pouch
traits.description: Auto-collect wood. Extras drop if your inventory is full.

traits.name: Verdant Surge
traits.description: Spell Menu: 3 runes advance sapling growth along a 20-block wave.

traits.name: Canopy Care
traits.description: Saplings and apples drop 50% more often from harvested trees. No shears or Silk Touch.

traits.name: Seed Keeper
traits.description: Replant has a 25% chance to keep each sapling it uses.

traits.name: Gale Cleave
traits.description: Spend 10 runes in the Spell Menu to harvest up to three trees, capped at 64 tree blocks. Supported giant mushrooms count too.

traits.name: Steady Axe II
traits.description: 20% chance to save axe durability.

traits.name: Fleeceweave
traits.description: Spend 10 runes in the Spell Menu to turn a tree or giant mushroom into matching wool permanently. No wood drops or Woodcutting XP.

traits.name: Master Lumberjack
traits.description: Turn on, then sneak-chop up to 32 logs from one recognized tree. Normal durability and protection apply.

traits.name: Grovewarden title
traits.description: Choose the Grovewarden title in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Fishing
description: Wait less, recover missed bites and catch rare trophies.
training: Cast your rod and reel in successful catches to level up.
Bonus fish, treasure and trophies do not give extra experience.
rules: Leveling reduces your wait for bites. Lure and normal fishing conditions still matter.
Trophies and treasure upgrades need open water. Trophies take priority over treasure and bonus fish.
Tackle Pouch sends catches to your inventory. If it’s full, they drop normally.

traits.name: Patient Angler
traits.description: Wait up to 25% less for bites as you level.

traits.name: Careful Cast
traits.description: 10% chance to save rod durability when you catch something.

traits.name: Tackle Pouch
traits.description: Auto-collect catches. Extras drop if your inventory is full.

traits.name: Fresh Catch
traits.description: 10% chance to double an ordinary fish. Treasure and trophies are never doubled.

traits.name: Trophy Angler
traits.description: 2% chance to replace an open-water fish with a rare trophy, recording its species, size and catcher.

traits.name: Second Chance
traits.description: 25% chance for a missed bite to return once per cast. Listen for the chime.

traits.name: Treasure Hunter
traits.description: 2% chance to replace an open-water fish with treasure, if it did not become a trophy.

traits.name: Master Angler
traits.description: Open-water fish can become legendary trophies (0.5%) or rare trophies (4%).

traits.name: Angler title
traits.description: Choose the Angler title in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Magic
description: Cast water and fire spells. Level up to improve mana regeneration, damage and healing.
training: Use staff spells to damage enemy mobs.
Healing, utility spells, peaceful creatures, other players do not train Magic.
rules: Right-click a staff to cast. Sneak + swap hands changes spells; with an offhand staff, use sneak + right-click. Equip only one staff at a time.
Each cast uses one Magic Rune plus mana. Craft 1 flint and 1 lapis lazuli into 8 runes. Right-click a rune for the Spell Menu.
You have 100 mana. It starts refilling three seconds after casting. Leveling improves regeneration, damage, burns and healing—not spell duration or terrain effects.
Downpour needs no skill level: spend 1 rune to water exposed farmland and put out fires along a 20-block path. Wait 10 seconds between casts.
Mining, Woodcutting and Construction spells unlock through those skills. Protection and combat restrictions still apply.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +5% mana regeneration and +0% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Water Bolt
traits.description: Water Staff: a traveling bolt with a brief slow. 10 mana; 1.5-second shared cooldown.

traits.name: Tidal Surge
traits.description: Water Staff: a wave that slows, pushes and extinguishes. 30 mana; 10-second cooldown.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +5% mana regeneration and +5% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +10% mana regeneration and +5% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Healing Spring
traits.description: Water Staff: a ten-second pool that heals players and peaceful creatures. 40 mana; 25-second cooldown.

traits.name: Whirlpool
traits.description: Water Staff: pull enemies into a pool for six seconds. 45 mana; 20-second cooldown.

traits.name: Ember Bolt
traits.description: Fire Staff: a traveling bolt of flame. 10 mana; 1.5-second shared cooldown.

traits.name: Featherbound
traits.description: Spell Menu: 2 runes for a boosted jump or slow fall. Jump or start falling within three seconds; lasts until landing. 20-second cooldown.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +10% mana regeneration and +10% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Firestorm
traits.description: Fire Staff: rain fire over a targeted area. 45 mana; 15-second cooldown.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +15% mana regeneration and +10% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Inferno Nova
traits.description: Fire Staff: an expanding close-range blast with four seconds of burn. 35 mana; 12-second cooldown.

traits.name: Superheat
traits.description: Spell Menu: 3 runes double one furnace, blast furnace, smoker or lit campfire’s speed for 30 seconds. 45-second cooldown.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +15% mana regeneration and +15% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Flame Lance
traits.description: Fire Staff: charge 0.75 seconds to spear and carry up to three targets over 24 blocks. Can pin them to walls; burns for four seconds. 40 mana; 12-second cooldown.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +20% mana regeneration and +15% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +20% mana regeneration and +20% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +25% mana regeneration and +20% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +25% mana regeneration and +25% spell damage and healing.

traits.name: Wizard title
traits.description: Choose the Wizard title in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Construction
tagline: Build a place worth returning to.
description: Build and craft to gain reach, teleport home and build as a flying spirit.
training: Build with new materials, craft building items and furniture, or use a stonecutter.
Complete each Hearthstone stage for the first time, and build your first Inn and Stable, for bonus experience.
Breaking and replacing blocks does not count. Reclaimed materials stay ineligible, even after crafting or processing.
rules: Builder’s Reach extends block placement while you hold building materials. It does not extend mining or attack range.
Home bonuses work only in your own territory. Hunger perks save food but do not refill it.
Right-click a Magic Rune for spells. Bedbound and Hearthward need three seconds standing still and share a five-minute cooldown. Wait 15 seconds after combat to cast.
Personal Chest opens your 27-slot Ender Chest. Your items stay saved across worlds and restarts.
Astral Projection lets you fly and build in your territory, but not attack. Your body stays vulnerable; damage hurts you and ends the spell. Press Shift+F to return, or stay as long as you like.

traits.name: Builder’s Reach
traits.description: +0.5 blocks of placement reach while holding building materials.

traits.name: Bedbound
traits.description: Spend 2 runes and stand still for three seconds to return beside your active bed.

traits.name: Hearthward
traits.description: Spend 3 runes and stand still for three seconds to return atop your Hearthstone’s gold heart.

traits.name: Builder’s Reach
traits.description: +1 block of placement reach while holding building materials.

traits.name: Personal Chest
traits.description: Spend 1 rune to open your 27-slot chest from any world. No cooldown; blocked during combat or Astral Projection.

traits.name: Comforts of Home
traits.description: Hunger and saturation drain 50% slower in your territory.

traits.name: Astral Projection
traits.description: Spend 4 runes to fly and build in your territory while your body stays vulnerable. Stand still for three seconds to cast; three-minute cooldown. No time limit; Shift+F returns.

traits.name: Builder’s Reach
traits.description: +1.5 blocks of placement reach while holding building materials.

traits.name: Builder’s Stride
traits.description: +10% movement speed while holding building materials in your territory, outside combat.

traits.name: Well Provisioned
traits.description: Stop hunger drain in your territory. Food does not refill, and exhaustion from outside can still use saturation.

traits.name: Builder’s Reach
traits.description: +2 blocks of placement reach while holding building materials.

traits.name: Master Architect
traits.description: Construction spells cost 1 fewer rune, with a minimum of 1.

traits.name: Architect title
traits.description: Choose the Architect title in Hearthstone → Titles.
